consequences: No raw prompts, free-text gist, private evidence, exact domain scores or hidden reasoning are exported. Raw evidence remains outside this L0 bridge and needs a separately scoped flow.
Projection revision compares only permitted views; unknown/missing/null/false/zero and source-stage differences remain distinct.
context: Frame metadata alone cannot debug actual controls and domain bands; delivery snapshots can differ from generation input and arbitrary recursive export would leak private content.
decision: Capture bounded, strict scalar/enum/band/count/reference-hash projections immediately after the generation disclosure/budget seal, with failure isolation; persist in encrypted execution evidence and strip from timeline polling. Fetch a single validated owner/conversation/turn-scoped frame through Gateway and main-window native IPC. Mark old wave snapshots as legacy source, never generation input.
